  "pros": [
    "Effectively manages and tracks multiple construction projects.",
    "Streamlines collaboration on workflow charts and automates reporting.",
    "Provides a reliable and secure platform for long-term use."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Experienced an initial learning curve that was somewhat overwhelming.",
    "Lacks an auto-save feature, requiring manual saving.",
    "Limited customization options compared to other tools."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This planning and project control engineer found Smartsheet to be a highly functional tool for managing and tracking multiple construction projects over two years. While the initial learning curve was steep, they ultimately found it user-friendly for project management and effective for collaboration and automating reports. Despite some frustrations with limited customization and lack of auto-save, the platform's reliability and core capabilities made it a valuable asset for their large construction company."
